【原视频简介】
Taking care of your health just got easier, thanks to my sponsor Zocdoc — start here at: https://zocdoc.com/laurafarms

"Roger's Hay Day" is available for Pre-order at https://laurafarmsbook.com My mission is to get this book in as many kids' hands as possible. We are over 30% of the way to our goal!! 

We are SO proud to offer you and your family First Market Beef: https://firstmarketbeef.com/ Inventory goes VERY fast!! Check out the website and get your email entered to be notified when we restock. Thank you so much to everyone who has placed orders already. We are so grateful you trust us to help feed your family. We have shipped to 49 states!

How is September here already? Today on the farm we hire a new worker. We see if Bessie can make our lives a little easier. What do you think? Would you hire a robot? Thank you for spending Fridays with us here on the farm. We love doing what we do every day! Have a great weekend. 

#farming #tractor #home #robot 

Check out the shirts I love to wear! Happy 250th America!  https://www.bunkerbranding.com/pages/laura-farms

GRANT AND LAURA ARE HAPPILY MARRIED!! There are so many scams these days, be sure to visit https://laurafarms.com to see my REAL and ONLY social media accounts, check local weather, news, and markets, and stay up to date! I am not messaging anyone. I'm so sorry, but if you think you're messaging me privately, that is a scam: Don't fall for it!!! 

Whether you're curious about farm life, technology and practices, or just want to see some…
